nodes.name: app.js
nodes.summary: Browser application coordinating Supabase account state, cloud refreshes, dashboard/roster/charge/payment views, accessible forms, confirmations, receipts, and backup/export flows. Domain arithmetic lives in model.js and persistence in LedgerStore.

nodes.name: form
nodes.summary: URL-encodes request form values for the authentication transport.

nodes.name: modal
nodes.summary: Opens an accessible dialog, captures the original form draft, serializes submission, checks fields, and keeps failed edits available.

nodes.name: close
nodes.summary: Closes a non-saving dialog, clears its draft, and restores focus to its opener or the main region.

nodes.name: dirty
nodes.summary: Compares current form entries against the captured draft to detect unsaved changes.

nodes.name: requestClose
nodes.summary: Blocks closing while saving and presents an explicit discard choice when the form is dirty.

nodes.name: required
nodes.summary: Requires a present bounded string field or returns a generic validation failure.

nodes.name: studentForm
nodes.summary: Creates or edits a student and agreed monthly fee while preserving historical charges.

nodes.name: chargesForm
nodes.summary: Previews duplicate-safe monthly charge creation for active students, then commits the selected month.

nodes.name: paymentForm
nodes.summary: Selects an unpaid charge, collects actual receipt details, applies model validation, and commits a partial or full payment.

nodes.name: editCharge
nodes.summary: Updates charge amount/due/note while preventing reductions below payments already received.

nodes.name: archiveStudent
nodes.summary: Confirms archive/restore and toggles future-charge eligibility while retaining financial history.

nodes.name: voidPayment
nodes.summary: Requires a correction reason, marks the payment voided, and retains the original record in history.

nodes.name: receipt
nodes.summary: Builds an escaped printable payment acknowledgment with dates, method, reference, and void status.

nodes.name: download
nodes.summary: Creates a temporary Blob URL for a browser download and revokes it after use.

nodes.name: exportCharges
nodes.summary: Exports selected-month charges with student details, amounts, balances, and derived status.

nodes.name: exportPayments
nodes.summary: Exports the full payment history, including voided entries and correction reasons.

nodes.name: cloud.js
nodes.summary: Creates the Supabase client with persisted PKCE authentication sessions and implements owner-filtered JSON ledger loading and revision-checked writes with mutation-ID reconciliation.

nodes.name: LedgerStore
nodes.summary: Creates the Supabase client with persisted PKCE authentication sessions and implements owner-filtered JSON ledger loading and revision-checked writes with mutation-ID reconciliation.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.constructor
nodes.summary: Stores the Supabase client and owner ID with initial expected revision zero.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.load
nodes.summary: Reads only the selected owner row and validates its ledger; intentionally leaves expected revision adoption to the UI.

nodes.name: LedgerStore.save
nodes.summary: Increments the expected revision, validates the snapshot, inserts/compares revision atomically, and reconciles uncertain completion by a unique mutation ID.
